adjudication_records.issue_text: app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:28 — `render json: { members: ..., meta: {...} }` replaces the bare JSON array formerly returned by public `/groups/:name/members`, so every existing API/plugin consumer iterating the array response breaks silently after this change (P1, conf 75)

adjudication.rationale: The diff clearly changes `GroupsController#members` from `render_serialized(members.to_a, GroupUserSerializer)` (previously returning a serialized collection) to `render json: { members: ..., meta: ... }`, i.e. a different top-level JSON shape. The frontend was updated accordingly (`group.findMembers()` now expects `result.members` and `result.meta`), but any external client/plugin expecting the old bare array/collection response from `/groups/:name/members` would indeed break due to this un-versioned response-format change. That’s a concrete, diff-grounded compatibility concern, though not provably a functional defect within the PR itself.

adjudication_records.issue_text: app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/group/members.hbs:6 — public group members page now renders only `members` from a single `findMembers()` call with default `limit: 50` and has no next/previous controls, so any group with more than 50 members is silently truncated to the first 50 (previously non-automatic groups showed everyone) (P1, conf 100)

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `GroupsController#members` to always paginate with `limit = (params[:limit] || 50)` and `offset` (no longer only for automatic groups), returning `{members, meta}` instead of all users. On the client, `Discourse.Group` now has `limit: 50`/`offset: 0` defaults and `findMembers()` always requests `/groups/<name>/members.json` with that limit/offset and sets `members` on the group model. The public route `discourse/routes/group-members.js.es6` now calls `model.findMembers()` once in `setupController` and the public template `discourse/templates/group/members.hbs` iterates `{{#each m in members}}` with no next/previous actions/controls (unlike the new admin UI pagination). This means groups with >50 members will display only the first page (50) with no way to access the rest, i.e., silent truncation introduced by this change.

adjudication_records.issue_text: app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22 — `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` has no upper clamp, so `?limit=1000000` on an automatic group like trust_level_0 materializes and serializes the entire user table (the old 200 cap is gone) (P2, conf 75)

adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the diff changes pagination to `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and applies it unconditionally, with no upper bound, then does `group.users.order(:username_lower).limit(limit).offset(offset)` and serializes the result. This allows a request like `?limit=1000000` to fetch and serialize an extremely large number of users (especially for large/automatic groups like `trust_level_0`). The previous implementation effectively capped automatic-group pagination at 200 via `(params[:limit] || 200).to_i` and did not remove that cap; this change removes any such cap/regression in resource usage control.
